summary: Douglas County, OR, Ninemile Mountain tower: planned 1933, dated 1933 or 1934 (sources differ), staffed 1941, an AWS post in 1943, now listed as gone.

facts.design: 40-foot pole tower, L-4 type, with an R1 cab
facts.status_note: Oregon lookout list marks it gone; Oregon lookouts page says removed with no date; firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1940s. No demolition date found.
facts.agency: Siskiyou National Forest; Douglas County Fire Patrol

events.note: Shake cabin, per firelookout.com only; the Oregon lookouts page does not mention it
Roseburg News-Review item of 21 October 1933 describes a 40-foot tower with lightning protection already constructed
A 1939 forest history and firelookout.com date the 40-foot tower to 1934; conflicts with the 1933 newspaper item
Slash burn near the lookout got away in a warm, dry gale in December 1933; cleared two or three hundred feet on each side
May 1940 plan treats the site as supplementary to Mt. Reuben for fire detection, and notes more favorable country for fuel moisture
Staffed 94 days this season; communications by forest line to Pacific Telephone and Telegraph and on to Rand Ranger Station

Aircraft Warning Service station George 9-4 activated 16 July and deactivated 14 October 1943, listed under the Roseburg Filter Center; placed in inactive status 14 October with recommendation to retain
Abandoned in the 1940s; firelookout.com gives only the decade, so no year is recorded

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 21 October 1933 newspaper item says the tower was already constructed. The 1939 forest history and firelookout.com give 1934. The story reports both dates and does not choose one.
firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1940s; the Oregon lookouts page says removed with no date. Both are recorded. No source gives a year or method of removal.

notes_for_editor: Three sources only; two searches found nothing else about an Oregon Ninemile lookout (results were Montana sites and other Douglas County towers). The Oregon lookouts page quotes newspapers and a 1939 forest history second-hand; originals not checked. Dates conflict (1933 vs 1934), removal date and method unknown, and no source describes the site today or public access, so access is omitted rather than set. The 1928 shake cabin appears only on firelookout.com. The brief's coordinates, 'gone' status and 40 ft height agree with the sources; no corrections proposed. The Oregon lookouts page's 'Removed' line is a single word with no date.
